breakouts.title: Add counts to year filter options

clarified_description: The changelog's year filter currently lists years as bare numbers, so a reader cannot tell a busy year from a quiet one without selecting it. This change appends a per-year entry count to each option in the compact form `2026 (4)`, and appends the total to the default option in the form `All years (4)`. Counts are derived from the same `entries` array that drives the list below the filter, so the numbers in the options always agree with what selecting the year displays. The count sits inside the `<option>` text content itself, so a screen reader hears it as part of the option rather than as a separate element. The control's existing keyboard behaviour is unchanged — it remains a native `<select>` with its existing `<label>` association and `aria-label`. The existing count paragraph above the filter (which says how many entries are currently shown for the active selection) is unchanged: it answers a different question and is kept as-is.

constraints.detail: The `entries` array passed into `ChangelogFilteredList` remains the single source of truth. Per-year counts and the total must be derived from that same array in the same render, not from any cached or precomputed side channel, so that the filter counts and the displayed list can never disagree.

Accessibility: the count must be part of the `<option>`'s text content. An `aria-label` on an `<option>` replaces the visible text for AT and would create two truths that can drift; that pattern is disallowed for this feature.

Framework: Next.js 16.2.6 / React 19.2.4 breaking changes apply — read `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` before writing Next.js-specific code (per repository AGENTS.md). This change stays inside two existing client components and does not need new Next.js APIs.

contracts.definition: `YearFilter` prop shape changes from `{ years: number[]; selected: number | null; onChange: (year: number | null) => void }` to `{ years: Array<{ year: number; count: number }>; totalCount: number; selected: number | null; onChange: (year: number | null) => void }`. Order of `years` is preserved (caller supplies newest-first).

data_changes.change: No change. The shape stored in `data/changelog.json` and shared with `pixie-sandbox/sandbox-changelog-api` is untouched.

deferred_decisions: Whether to memoise the per-year count derivation with `useMemo` in `ChangelogFilteredList`. The engineer may add memoisation if profiling suggests it; the entry set is small (single-digit today) so a straight reduction is acceptable.
must: WHEN the changelog page renders the year filter the system shall display each year option as the year followed by a space, an opening parenthesis, the count of entries for that year, and a closing parenthesis (for example `2026 (4)`).

WHEN the changelog page renders the year filter the system shall display the default option as the literal text `All years`, a space, an opening parenthesis, the total count of entries across all years, and a closing parenthesis (for example `All years (4)`).

The system shall derive both per-year counts and the total count from the same `entries` array that is passed to the filtered list, so a selected year's option count equals the number of entries displayed for that year.
The system shall place the count inside the `<option>` element's text content, so that assistive technology reads the count as part of the option and not as a separate element.
The system shall preserve the existing `<label htmlFor="year-filter">` association and the existing `aria-label="Filter entries by year"` on the `<select>` control.
The system shall preserve the existing native `<select>` element and its keyboard operability; no ARIA roles, custom keyboard handlers, or non-native option markup shall be introduced.
IF the `entries` array is empty THEN the system shall render the default option as `All years (0)` and no year options.
The system shall continue to list only years that have at least one entry in the option list (years are derived from `entries`, so no zero-count year option can appear).
The system shall keep the existing count paragraph above the `<select>` unchanged in wording and singular/plural behaviour (it describes the currently displayed list, not the per-year totals).
outcome: Readers can see how many entries each year has directly in the changelog's year filter, so a busy year and a quiet one are distinguishable without selecting them.

standards_applied.standard: ANZ Digital — Date & Time Display Standard (DTS-04)
standards_applied.why_not: The years in the filter are calendar years (`2026`), not user-facing dates. DTS-04 governs absolute date and relative time formats (`09 Sep 2026`, `3 days ago`); a bare four-digit year in a filter option is neither, and no time-of-day or zone is involved.

standards_applied.standard: ANZ Engineering — Database Write Result Standard (DWR-01)
standards_applied.why_not: This change is read-only display logic in a client component; it performs no database writes. There is no write result to inspect.

standards_applied.standard: ANZ Engineering — Discriminating Test Inputs Standard (DTI-01)

standards_applied.why_not: The visible strings introduced by this change are a four-digit year, a space, and a count in parentheses (plus the literal `All years`). None of that copy is sourced from work-tracking descriptions and none of it can contain a project key like `PAY-1234`.

swe_constraints: The `<option>` for a year must have text content exactly of the form `${year} (${count})` with a single ASCII space and standard ASCII parentheses — no non-breaking space, no en/em dash.
The default `<option>` must have text content exactly `All years (${total})` with the same spacing and punctuation.
No `aria-label`, `aria-describedby`, or nested elements inside any `<option>`. The option is text-only.
Preserve `<label htmlFor="year-filter">Year:</label>` and `<select id="year-filter" aria-label="Filter entries by year">` exactly.
Derive counts inline in `ChangelogFilteredList` from the same `entries` array used to derive the year set; do not introduce a memoised cache or a module-level precomputation.
Both files remain `'use client'`. No server component or new data-fetching path.
No new dependencies; use only what is already in `package.json`.
Tailwind styling on the control and its label is unchanged; this is a text-content change inside existing markup.

touches.reason: Accepts the new prop shape (`years: Array<{year, count}>`, `totalCount: number`) and embeds counts into each `<option>`'s text content.
Derives per-year counts and the total from the same `entries` array it already uses, and passes them to `YearFilter` via the new props.
Adds tests for count-in-option-text behaviour and updates any existing option-text assertion that would need to reflect the count.
Line 37's strict-equality check `t === '2026'` will break once option text includes a count; updated to substring match. Adds tests confirming per-year and total counts appearing in options.
